b: Streamlight has a number of excellent LED flashlights discounted on Amazon for Black Friday 2026.

The Microstream has a compact size, and the Stylus Pro is similar but with an extended penlight size.
Their USB-rechargeable flat-style flashlights are also discounted right now.
